Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our end: BrightPay is focused on reducing per-transaction inference cost for invoice processing and wants predictable latency under 150ms p95 for short prompts. We covered data residency, audit/log requirements, and typical peak concurrency (approx 120 concurrent users during batch runs).

Next best step: schedule a technical deep-dive where Sergio (solutions engineer) walks through the runtime architecture, KV/prefix caching options, and a short model-performance runbook for your workload. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 21 Apr, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 22 Apr, 14:00–15:00

Please confirm which slot works for your team and who will attend (engineering + security folks would be ideal). Once we agree, I will send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda.

I've attached the discovery notes I took during today's call — let me know if anything is off.
